name: app-settings-js
description: TypeScript SDK for the App Settings API. No dependencies; runs in browsers, Node, Bun and Deno.

scripts.build: bun run build:js && bun run build:types
scripts.build:js: bun build src/index.ts --outdir=dist --format=esm --target=node --sourcemap=linked && bun build src/index.ts --outdir=dist --entry-naming='[dir]/[name].cjs' --format=cjs --target=node --sourcemap=linked
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run clean && bun run build && bun run check
